positions.name: PantryRestockThresholdsByShelf
positions.frame: At what fill level should each pantry shelf be restocked, and what justifies treating the fastest-depleting shelves differently from the rest?
positions.why: The single statement carries a whole frame on its own. It keeps the 1 October one-third restock rule for most shelves and sets a half-full exception for oats and rice. It gives a run-out-speed rationale: a third full is under a day of stock on a Friday. It bears on the narrative about recurring operations running by explicit stated rules. No existing positions are supplied in the consult, so it is minted rather than attached to Position_NovemberFirstOperatingChanges, and no lineage edge is typed because that position is not a consult target.
